1778.instruction: Walk past the archway and around the pew; then stand between the third and forth podium , in front of the fifth seat.

413.instruction: Go through the archway to the right, and walk to the podium.

651.instruction: Go to exit of writing room. Stop between pillars.
phrases: Go to exit of writing room. Stop between pillars.

1624.instruction: Walk onto the platform on the right, pass two book stands. Wait between the second and the third.
phrases: Walk onto the platform on the right, pass two book stands. Wait between the second and the third.

1483.instruction: Turn around and walk along the wooden hallway.Wait the the wooden doorway.

783.instruction: Walk across the room, keeping the railing on your left.  Once you reach the sitting area, stop in front of the abacus on the right side of the first stuffed chair.

885.instruction: Go down the stairs to your right and stop when you get all the way down.

1552.instruction: Go up the stairs. Wait beside the support pillar for the stairs.

776.instruction: You need to walk down the stairs and when you get to the landing go to the last door on the right. Once you go inside the doorway of the bathroom wait.

507.instruction: Leave the kitchen, and walk through the pantry. In the hall take a left, and take a right at the end of the hall. Stop next to the plan on the table in the entryway.

893.instruction: Go straight ahead to the other side of the kitchen and stop right at the beginning of the long brown table.

14.instruction:
Move to the far left corner of the table
Proceed to the doorway to your right
walk into the kitchen with the stove on your right
proceed forward until the fridge is on your left
proceed forward once more until there is a small sink on your left and shelves on your right.

1263.instruction: Turn left and walk past the kitchen and then through the living room.  Turn right at the eye chart and stand next to the bathroom door.

1026.instruction: Exit the bedroom. Go to the right towards the kitchen. Stand next to the hallways located after the cabinets.

833.instruction: Go left and go through the first arch on the right then turn left and stop by the sink.

159.instruction: Walk  forward through the middle archway looking down a hallway, and stop.

1608.instruction: Go stand behind the nearest of the three chairs with white cushions at the kitchen bar.

1803.instruction: Walk through the vaulted hallway right next to you, and turn right, continuing through the opening that's just to the left of the stairs leading upwards. Continue forward, this time going through the door opening to the left of the mirror, stopping next to the bed on your right.

931.instruction: Enter the building and walk through the kitchen. Stop in the hall next to the ovens.

166.instruction: Go forward by the windows, and then stop by the lamp.
phrases: Go forward by the windows, and then stop by the lamp.

382.instruction: Walk across the patio to the other wall. Stop at the edge of the patio near the brick wall and the pillar of brick.
phrases: Walk across the patio to the other wall. Stop at the edge of the patio near the brick wall and the pillar of brick.

1677.instruction: Go down the stairs. Turn right and continue down another set of steps and go straight. Stop in front of the doors to the bathroom and laundry rooms.

1568.instruction: Go into the hall and stop in the bedroom across from the stairs.

370.instruction: Move through the kitchen with the square table to your right. Continue moving forward to the staircase just after the refrigerator. Walk up the stairs and stop 18 inches before the end of the stair railing to your right.

1186.instruction: Walk towards the silver refrigerator.  Walk up the steps on the left.  Wait at top of stairs.

500.instruction: Walk across the room and straight down the hallway. Wait in the doorway.

381.instruction: Pass through the bedroom with the bed to your left. Move into the hallway just past the cream-colored curtain on the window. Move through the doorway. Move down the hallway and pass through the hall entryway. Continue forward, crossing another hallway running parallel. Move just past the lone bar stool on your left and then stop.

1093.instruction: Go through closest doorway. Walk towards tub, then go into room with toilet.

1507.instruction: Go up the stairs and turn left at the top  Walk through the glass door and stop when you step inside the exercise room on the other side.

730.instruction: Walk past the sitting area and wait in the kitchen by the island.

1149.instruction: walk around the sofa then walk straight at the island table.

1174.instruction: Exit the closet and go the bedroom. Turn left and exit the bedroom. Walk straight to the top of the stairs and turn right. Walk straight forward and enter the bedroom in from of you. Wait just inside the doorway.

1708.instruction: Walk past the stairs and down the hall. Walk Through the entryway and stop just past the glass wine cellar.

107.instruction: Enter the bedroom and stand at the foot of the bed.  Walk right and exit the bedroom from the door with a letter "B" on the wall to your left.  Take a right turn out of the bedroom and walk in through another bedroom's door where you see a light colored shaggy rug.  Take another right turn and stand just through the door after the white little dog on the floor to your left.

1278.instruction: Exit the room. Go forward and enter the room with a dog statue on the floor. Turn left and exit the room. Go forward till the rail of the stair. Enter the room on the left and stop. Wait there.
phrases: Exit the room. Go forward and enter the room with a dog statue on the floor. Turn left and exit the room. Go forward till the rail of the stair. Enter the room on the left and stop. Wait there.

268.instruction: Walk up the stairs and wait on the second step of the second set of stairs.

1689.instruction: Keeping the closed door to your rear, traverse the long carpet until you walk passed the stairway leading up. You will then catch a glimpse of some stairs leading down and towards the outside. Go on and head down all of these stairs. Once at the bottom of the stairs, hang a right. Twist to the right and traverse the next set of stairs.Traveling quickly forward until your reach your destination of the display case. Stop moving until you are told next where to go.

7.instruction: Go straight past the pool. Walk between the bar and chairs.  Stop when you get to the corner of the bar.  That's where you will wait.
phrases: Go straight past the pool. Walk between the bar and chairs.  Stop when you get to the corner of the bar.  That's where you will wait.

640.instruction: Head past the bar along the side of the pool.  Turn right and stop inside of the sauna.
phrases: Head past the bar along the side of the pool.  Turn right and stop inside of the sauna.

1054.instruction: Walk along the poolside past the armchairs. Continue around the edge of the pool past the railings. Walk towards the open door with the two chairs up against the wall next to its entrance. Walk through the open doorway and into the spa area with fountains on the walls.

1605.instruction: Go out the door on the left, and turn left to go toward the bar. Go up the first set of stairs to your left.

553.instruction: Walk up the three steps, and go straight towards the room that is ahead of you that has a massage bed visible. Enter the room, and stop in front of the massage bed.

392.instruction: Turn around and walk across the dining room area. Enter the leftmost doorway. Wait by the glass sign on the left.

1657.instruction: Walk through the room past the ropes and stop in the doorway.
